description: For punch list, this completion sign-off form records observed deficiency, acceptance criterion, access need, correction owner, due date, and predecessor dependency. Its supporting evidence includes dated photo, test reading, inspection note, drawing reference, and reinspection result.

blocks.guidance: Link this punch list record to its evidence.

blocks.guidance: Capture room or grid location, system, responsible trade, contract reference, and turnover milestone for this punch list.

items: Source, date, author, and version can be identified

blocks.guidance: Escalate life-safety, water-intrusion, energized-system, occupancy, or concealed-work defects immediately. Route unresolved punch list work for review.

use_case: Use the completion sign-off form during deficiency capture, assignment, and verification when the punch list record must identify room or grid location, system, responsible trade, contract reference, and turnover milestone. Complete the applicable handoff for verified correction, owner acceptance, exception disposition, remaining-list reconciliation, and turnover handoff.
